Title: Azure SQL Data Warehouse: February 2016 update

Body.Content:
This post summarizes the new features released in Azure SQL Data Warehouse in February 2016:

  • T-SQL Implemented new T-SQL needed for SQL Server Management Studio integration.
  • Loading Improved PolyBase, enabling loads from public data sets.
  • Restore Added the ability to restore SQL Data Warehouse backups to any server in any region.
  • Monitoring Integrated views of Data Warehouse Unit consumption for the current workload.
  • Documentation Released a broad set of documentation additions and changes.

To learn more, see:

  • February update for Azure SQL Data Warehouse
  • Azure SQL Data Warehouse
  • What is Azure SQL Data Warehouse?
  • Get an Azure subscription: Develop and test cloud solutions
